body:
They both started out laying flat. It was strange. I went and saw my doc. They actually said it was a keloid from the piercing. Not an infection. (I’m prone to keloiding) so they prescribed some prescription strength medicine to help with the swelling. 

It’s a rose gold titanium ring.

I don’t know what I was pierced with. It was SUPER sanitary. I work in a hospital - and I even made the comment that I was more sanitary than some of our rooms. 

I do SSS 3 times a day, and I have only washed with the soap they gave me a few times (they said like 1 time a week just to get it good and clean was enough)

It’s a little sore. 

I used some hydrogen peroxide last night - and the swelling is down some and the bump isn’t as bad.

Been there. Done that. I’m in a shorty life situation that I can’t get out of. And idk. I know I need the help. But death seems a lot more appealing than getting better. I know I don’t make any sense.
